statement:
Let $X$ be a sober topological space and let $\delta : X \to \mathbf{Z}$ be a dimension function on $X$. Then $X$ is catenary. Moreover, for any $x \leadsto y$
we have
$$
\delta(x) - \delta(y) =
\text{codim}\left(\overline{\{y\}}, \ \overline{\{x\}}\right).
$$

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dimension-function-catenary}
Let $X$ be a topological space. If $X$ is sober and has a dimension
function, then $X$ is catenary. Moreover, for any $x \leadsto y$
we have
$$
\delta(x) - \delta(y) =
\text{codim}\left(\overline{\{y\}}, \ \overline{\{x\}}\right).
$$
